verses.html: A Psalm of David. The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.title: A Psalm of David.

verses.html: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.html: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.text: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.html: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.text: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.html: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.html: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.text: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.html: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
